classification: controlled local replay of public shipped Pace design HTML with declared static assets

provider.name: REA Playwright browser scenario capture provider

source.transformations: No HTML-byte modification. HTML served as text/html on loopback. The 35 declared static assets were mirrored under their original URL paths. No source-repository code was used in the replay.

result.local_server_cleanup: Owned loopback server stopped after capture, exit130 from KeyboardInterrupt.

bounded_observations: The selected public document exposes design-token groups, type and spacing sections, component-role sections and motion documentation in DOM and accessibility evidence.
The DOM contains 19 occurrences of base-ui markers. This is a shipped/runtime fingerprint, not proof of any particular component implementation.
The final capture still contains var(--ink) token labels. Resolved style values and complete hydration readiness were not established.
not_verified: Pointer or keyboard interaction beyond waiting for the heading
limitations: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.
redistribution: No full third-party HTML, DOM, accessibility text, JavaScript bundle, font, image, or private repository source is committed.
